anomalies.observed: In the 'Capacitive Touch Button (TSC)' block the 1 kΩ resistor R9 is wired in series from the net labelled NET0013 (U3/PB7, pin 59) to the electrode pad A3 pin 1 (BTN), while the 22 nF capacitor C2 is connected from the net labelled NET0011 (U3/PB5, pin 57) to GND. The electrode's series resistor therefore sits on the sampling-capacitor I/O and the sampling capacitor on the electrode I/O.
anomalies.expected: Per the specification, TSC_G2_IO2 (PB5, pin 57) is the touch I/O that goes through the 1 kΩ series resistor (R8) to the electrode's BTN pin, and TSC_G2_IO4 (PB7, pin 59) is the sampling I/O that carries the 22 nF sampling capacitor (C14) to GND. R9 should therefore connect NET0011 (PB5) to A3.1 and C2 should connect NET0013 (PB7) to GND.

evidence.quote: TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin "BTN" (the touch electrode)
TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND) — this is the TSC sampling capacitor for the group
Capacitive Touch Button (TSC) block: labels NET0013 and NET0011 at the MCU-side; R9 '1k' in series to A3 pin 1 'BTN'; C2 '22n' from the other net to GND

anomalies.impact: The STM32 TSC group 2 would be configured by the intended firmware with the electrode on IO2 (PB5) and the sampling capacitor on IO4 (PB7); with the two I/Os swapped the charge-transfer measurement is performed on the wrong pins, so the capacitive touch button will not sense correctly (unresponsive or erratic key).

anomalies.observed: The MCU's SWD pins PA13 (pin 46), PA14 (pin 49) and PB3 (pin 55) carry the labels NET0017, NET0019 and NET0002 respectively, while the programming connector J2's SWDIO (pin 2), SWCLK (pin 3) and SWO (pin 5) carry the labels NET0004, NET0010 and NET0014. No label name is shared between the two ends, so the debug signals are not common nets (only VCC, GND and NET0006/~RESET reach J2).
anomalies.expected: J1/J2 is the SWD/JTAG programming header, so its SWDIO, SWCLK and SWO pins must be on the same nets as the MCU's PA13 (SWDIO), PA14 (SWCLK) and PB3 (SWO) — i.e. the MCU-side and connector-side labels must be identical.

evidence.quote: Its pins are VCC, GND, ~{RESET}, SWCLK, SWDIO, SWO — a standard ARM debug/programming interface, not a user I/O or power cable.
'Programming (SWD)' block: J2 Conn_ARM_SWD_TagConnect_TC2030 with pin 2 SWDIO, pin 3 SWCLK, pin 5 SWO carrying labels NET0004/NET0010/NET0014, while U3 PA13/PA14/PB3 carry NET0017/NET0019/NET0002

anomalies.impact: The Tag-Connect programmer cannot drive or read the SWD lines, so the board cannot be programmed or debugged through J2 even though the connector, reset and supplies are correctly attached.

parsed.summary: The drawing deviates from the intended design in the touch-sensing wiring: the 1 kΩ electrode series resistor (R9) and the 22 nF TSC sampling capacitor (C2) are attached to the swapped group-2 I/O nets (PB7 vs PB5), so the capacitive button would not work with the intended firmware. A second, less certain deviation is that the MCU's SWDIO/SWCLK/SWO nets (NET0017/NET0019/NET0002) do not match the nets on the programming connector J2 (NET0004/NET0010/NET0014), which would leave the debug interface unconnected.
